title: God's chosen servant

nodes.label: B
nodes.title:
The fulfillment of the prophecy.
The correspondence is about silence or inconspicuous. The center part is about fulfillent of the prophecy (Isaiah 42:1-4). This structure also emphasizes that Jesus is promised messiah in Old Testament
